steps.title: Brief and site visit
steps.description: We meet, visit the plot and record what it needs.

steps.title: Concept design
steps.description: Schematic floor plans, a preliminary client brief and mood boards.

steps.description: Elevations, basic sections and 3D views for your approval.

steps.title: Structural design
steps.description: Structural and MEP drawings checked against the design, so nothing clashes.

steps.description: Drawings for local approvals, and help choosing a verified contractor.
